svg.script: (()=>{const q=s=>document.querySelector(s),qa=s=>[...document.querySelectorAll(s)],p=new URLSearchParams((location.hash||'').slice(1)),token=p.get('token')||(location.hash||'').slice(1);let init=null,types=new Set(),target='',prio=0;const send=o=>{o={...o,token};try{parent&&parent!==self&&parent.postMessage(o,'*')}catch{}try{opener&&opener.postMessage(o,'*')}catch{}};const show=(s,v)=>q(s).classList.toggle('hidden',!v);const fill=(s,a,z)=>{let e=q(s);while(e.firstChild)e.removeChild(e.firstChild);if(!a?.length)a=[{label:z||'없음',value:''}];for(const x of a){let o=document.createElementNS('http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml','option');o.value=String(x.value??x.id??x.name??x.label??'');o.textContent=String(x.label??x.name??x.value??'');e.appendChild(o)}};const stat=s=>q('#status').textContent=s||'';function render(){let v=types.has('video'),a=types.has('audio'),d=types.has('data');show('#media',v||a);show('#vo',v);show('#ao',a);show('#data',d);show('#fmtSec',d);show('#targetSec',types.size);show('#drive',target==='drive');show('#manage',d&&target==='drive');qa('[data-type]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',types.has(b.dataset.type)));qa('[data-target]').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('on',target===b.dataset.target));q('#run').textContent=(types.size?[...types].map(x=>x==='video'?'영상':x==='audio'?'음성':'데이터').join('+'):'')+' 저장'}function start(d){init=d;let v=d.video||{};q('#title').textContent=v.title||'YouTube 수집';q('#sub').textContent=[v.channel,v.publishedAt,v.duration,v.views].filter(Boolean).join(' · ')||'항목을 선택하세요';if(v.thumbnail)q('#thumb').setAttribute('src',v.thumbnail);fill('#vq',d.media?.video,'가능한 영상 없음');fill('#aq',d.media?.audio,'가능한 음성 없음');fill('#df',d.drive?.files,'파일 선택');fill('#ds',d.drive?.sheets,'시트 선택');fill('#dc',d.drive?.categories,'카테고리 선택');show('#dup',!!d.duplicate);types=d.mode==='media'?new Set(['video']):d.mode==='collect'?new Set(['data']):new Set();stat('준비됨');render()}qa('[data-type]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let t=b.dataset.type;types.has(t)?types.delete(t):types.add(t);render()});qa('[data-target]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{target=b.dataset.target;render()});q('#cc').onchange=e=>show('#co',e.target.checked);qa('[data-star]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{prio=+b.dataset.star===prio?0:+b.dataset.star;qa('[data-star]').forEach(x=>{let on=+x.dataset.star<=prio;x.classList.toggle('on',on);x.textContent=on?'★':'☆'})});qa('[data-new]').forEach(b=>b.onclick=()=>{let k=b.dataset.new,n=prompt(k==='file'?'새 파일 이름':k==='sheet'?'새 시트 이름':'새 카테고리 이름');if(n?.trim())send({type:'YT_BM_ACTION',action:'create-drive-item',kind:k,name:n.trim()})});const close=()=>send({type:'YT_BM_ACTION',action:'close'});q('#x').onclick=close;q('#close2').onclick=close;q('#openOld').onclick=()=>send({type:'YT_BM_ACTION',action:'open-existing'});q('#run').onclick=()=>{if(!types.size)return stat('가져올 항목을 선택하세요.');if(!target)return stat('저장 위치를 선택하세요.');let o={type:'YT_BM_ACTION',action:'save',types:[...types],target};if(types.has('video'))o.videoQuality=q('#vq').value;if(types.has('audio'))o.audioQuality=q('#aq').value;if(types.has('data')){o.fields=qa('#fields input:checked,details input:checked').map(x=>x.value);o.format=q('#fmt').value;o.comments={count:+q('#cnt').value,sort:q('#sort').value};o.management={tags:q('#tags').value.trim(),priority:prio,status:q('#state').value,memo:q('#memo').value}}if(target==='drive')o.drive={file:q('#df').value,sheet:q('#ds').value,category:q('#dc').value};stat('처리 요청 중…');send(o)};addEventListener('message',e=>{let d=e.data||{};if(d.token!==token)return;if(d.type==='YT_BM_INIT')start(d);if(d.type==='YT_BM_STATUS')stat(d.message);if(d.type==='YT_BM_DRIVE_OPTIONS'){fill('#df',d.files||init?.drive?.files,'파일 선택');fill('#ds',d.sheets||init?.drive?.sheets,'시트 선택');fill('#dc',d.categories||init?.drive?.categories,'카테고리 선택')}});send({type:'YT_BM_READY'})})();
